syllabus: N5 is planned as 8 units of 10 points (this is unit 1: noun sentences). Is the order sensible for a beginner, and are any of the 80 points better left to N4 (for example 〜なくてもいい, 〜と思います, 〜つもり, 〜ほうがいい, 〜なければならない)? The full list is in the app's syllabus file and can be sent on request.
style: Exam-style questions, week-test items, the scene check, reading passages and listening choices are written with spaces between phrases, as the N5 paper does (これは　わたしの　本です。). Teach and drill text has no spaces but shows readings over the kanji. Is this the right split?

Only the about 100 kanji of the N5 list are ever written in kanji; every other word is in kana (かいしゃいん, じしょ, つくえ). In teach and drill text every kanji word has its reading above it; in exam-style text none do. Does this match what an N5 learner should see?

n5u01d1.p1: The second rule row is 〜さん ＋ は ＋ 〜 ＋ です (another person's name + さん). Useful, or confusing on the first page?
n5u01d1.c1: Answer です. The third option is ですか (a question). Is it clearly wrong when the next sentence says she teaches Japanese?
n5u01d1.d4: Answer ではありません. Please confirm ですか and ありません (without では) are clearly wrong here.
n5u01d1.d5: Star item. Please confirm orders like 日本語のわたしは… are clearly wrong.
n5u01d1.e3: Star item. Please confirm 日本語の父は… is clearly wrong.
n5u01d1.r1: 発話表現 (there is no picture; the picture is described in a line of English). Are the three spoken choices natural for meeting a new teacher, and only one fitting?
n5u01d2.c1: B repeats the name (やまださんは学生です). Natural, or should B just say 学生です?
n5u01d2.d4: Answer わたしもです ('me too'). Natural in this exchange?
n5u01d2.e3: Rewritten after the check (A：これは　先生の　本ですか。). Please read once.
n5u01d2.k: Classroom scene. Desk, dictionary and homework have no N5 kanji, so 休み is the eighth word. Fine?
n5u01d3.d6: Star item (あれは何の店ですか). Please confirm 何の店はあれ is clearly wrong.
n5u01d3.e3: Star item (この花はいくらですか). いくら comes from unit 2; fair here?
n5u01d3.r1: Quick response. Option 3 (あれは、おかしです) is wrong only because the man said それ, so the item is near the woman. Clearly wrong to a native ear?
n5u01d4.d6: Star item. Please confirm 父は母と先生です is clearly wrong.
n5u01d4.e3: Star item. Please confirm 日本語のわたしの先生 is clearly wrong (only わたしの日本語の先生).
n5u01d5.p1: The watch note uses わたしはキムですね as the wrong sentence. A good example of misused ね?
n5u01d5.d5: Changed to 電車が来ましたよ after the check. Natural for someone who has just seen the train?
n5u01d5.e1: ね or よ: よ is the answer (いすの上にかさがありますよ). Is ね clearly wrong with the context given?
n5u01d5.e2: ね is the answer (both walking in the heat). Is よ clearly wrong here? Several items add a bracketed line saying who knows what; are those lines clear?
n5u01d6.c1: Answer 先生のです. It relies on reading だれの as 'whose'. Clear enough?
n5u01d6.d3: Answer ね (both are looking at the calendar). Please confirm よ is clearly wrong here.
n5u01d6.e2: Answer よ (B tells A there is a class tomorrow too). Could a native hear 〜ありますね as a soft reminder and accept it?
n5u01d6.e3: Star item. The ★ was moved to わたしの after the check.
n5u01d6.k: Calendar scene: 月 read げつ as a day label is not a word on its own. Acceptable as a scene word?
n5u01t.6: Answer 本や. 国 as a wrong option feels weak; is it clearly wrong?
n5u01t.7: Rewritten after the check (りょうしん was N4): ふるい = あたらしくない. Please read once.
n5u01t.14: Answer と. Please confirm ノートのペン is clearly wrong.
n5u01t.15: Close in pattern to day 5 (two people looking, then ね). Too similar for a test item?
n5u01t.18: Rewritten after the check (リンさんは　中国の　人です). Please read once.
